doc.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Future plans and goodbyes
summary: He hopes to travel more on his own and the two thank each other.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: What’s in the near future for you?

Hopefully I’m going to start doing a little more travel on my own. I’ve got a little agent that I’m working with and he’s trying to book me some stuff, and where I’m not so boxed in with the Preservation Hall concept. I mean it’s a great thing to be part of, but I just have other statements that I want to make, and a few other seeds to sow.
Well it’s been a great pleasure.
And I’m sure we’ll cross paths again soon.
Thank you. All right. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
